text:
jess: quick thought — small helper (bot + tiny CLI) that wires change-windows, pins, and a one-line release-note generator so quick fixes are consistent. interested in a lightweight opt-in approach.

jess: example usage i sketched: 
```
/deploy-garden pin v1.4.3 --owner @alex --until=2026-03-25T20:00Z
/deploy-garden release-note "patch: fix kv cache init" --template quick
/deploy-garden rollback --id=20260325-1418 --reason="regression"
```

dan: nice. can we add `--snooze` to silence non-critical alerts during the change window? saves noise. :+1:

release-bot: created ticket DG-342 · pinned v1.4.3 (owner: jess) · change-window 2026-03-25T18:00Z→2026-03-25T20:00Z · link: https://internal.redwood/DG-342

sophia: curious about rollback safety — can we require a preflight gate that aborts if service error-rate > 0.5%? also send pager on failure.

jess: yes. plan is to add a preflight hook that queries telemetry and cancels+rolls back if thresholds exceeded. minimal config idea: 
```
preflight:
  - name: error-rate
    query: "rate(errors[2m])"
    threshold: 0.005
    fail_action: rollback
```

dan: also add `--dryrun` so the bot prints the infra steps and checks without mutating state. will help onboarding.

alex: i'll prototype a tiny repo with a CLI handler + bot integration tomorrow. can wire the pin and release-note templates into the README. :shipit:

jess: awesome — can you include a tiny release-note template too? i'd like one-liner + impact + rollback-key as required fields.

alex: yep. sample template I'll add: 
```
- summary: one line
- impact: single sentence
- rollback-key: command or ticket id
```

sophia: one more ask — if preflight fails during a change window, page the oncall (call if severity high). slack-only alerts are too slow.

dan: agreed. default `--pager=on` for prod deploys; toggle via flag.

jess: thanks — i'll add a short checklist in the README and an opt-in flag for teams. tagging follow-ups: @dan @alex @sophia

alex: will post prototype PR and short demo gif when ready.

jess: sweet. moving to follow-up board. :eyes:
